questions.q: What bothered King David about where the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh was staying?
questions.a: It bothered him that the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh was staying under only a tent while David was living in a house of cedar.

questions.q: What did Nathan tell David to do?
questions.a: Nathan told David to do all that was in his heart, because God was with him.

questions.q: What did Yahweh tell Nathan to say to David about building a house for Yahweh?
questions.a: Yahweh said that David was not to build a house for Yahweh to live in.

questions.q: Who did Yahweh tell to go and speak to David?
questions.a: Yahweh told Nathan to go and speak to David.

questions.q: Where does Yahweh say he has been living since he brought Israel out of Egypt?
questions.a: Yahweh says he has been living in a tent, moving from place to place with the people.

questions.q: What did Yahweh say he never told any of Israel’s leaders to do?
questions.a: Yahweh said he never told any of Israel’s leaders to build him a house of cedar.

questions.q: Why did Yahweh take David from the pasture and from following the sheep?
questions.a: He took David from the pasture and from following the sheep so that he would be ruler over Yahweh’s people Israel.

questions.q: What did Yahweh say that he would do for David’s name?
questions.a: He said that he would make David a name like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.

questions.q: Who would no longer oppress the people of Israel after Yahweh gave them a place where they could live and be troubled no more?
questions.a: Wicked people would no longer oppress Israel as they did before.

questions.q: What does Yahweh declare that he will do for David?
questions.a: Yahweh declares that he will build a house for David.

questions.q: What does Yahweh say that David’s descendant will do after David’s days are fulfilled?
questions.a: David’s descendant will build a house for Yahweh.

questions.q: What relationship does Yahweh say he will have with David’s descendant?
questions.a: Yahweh says he will be a father to him, and his descendant will be a son to him.

questions.q: For how long did Yahweh say that the throne of David’s descendant would be established?
questions.a: Yahweh said that the throne of David’s descendant would be established forever.

questions.q: What did Nathan do after Yahweh gave him this message and vision?
questions.a: Nathan went and told David everything that Yahweh had said to him.

questions.q: What did David say about himself when he prayed to Yahweh?
questions.a: David said he was not an important person and did not come from an important family, so he did not deserve all that Yahweh had done for him.

questions.q: What did David say that Yahweh had done for him because of what Yahweh had shown him about future generations?
questions.a: He said Yahweh had honored him and given him special recognition.

questions.q: What does David say Yahweh has done for his servant?
questions.a: David says Yahweh has done this great thing for his servant, according to his own heart.

questions.q: What does David say about Yahweh compared to other gods?
questions.a: David says there is no one like Yahweh and no other real God except him.

questions.q: What does David say is the reason that Yahweh rescued his people from Egypt and made them a people for himself?
questions.a: Yahweh rescued them from Egypt to make for himself a great and feared name.

questions.q: What does David say Yahweh made his people Israel to be forever?
questions.a: David says Yahweh made Israel his people forever, and Yahweh became their God.

questions.q: What does David ask Yahweh to do about the promise that he made to David concerning the establishment of David’s family forever?
questions.a: David asks Yahweh to do as Yahweh had spoken.

questions.q: What does David ask Yahweh to establish forever for his family?
questions.a: David asks Yahweh to establish the house of his servant David forever.

questions.q: What did Yahweh reveal to David that gave him courage to pray this way?
questions.a: Yahweh revealed to David that he would make some of David’s descendants kings.

questions.q: What did Yahweh promise to do for his servant David’s house?
questions.a: Yahweh promised to bless his servant David’s house and to do good things for David’s descendants.

commentary.text: —This chapter is the same as 2Sa 7. See what is there said upon it. It is very observable that what in Samuel is said to be, “for thy word's sake,” is here said to be, “for thy servant's sake,” ver. #(19). Jesus Christ is both the Word of God, Re 19:13, and the Servant of God, Isa 42:1; and it is for his sake, upon account of his mediation, that the promises are made good to all believers; it is in him, that they are yea and amen. For His sake it is done, for his sake it is made known; to him we owe all this greatness, from him we are to expect all these great things. They are the unsearchable riches of Christ, which, if by faith we see in themselves, and see in the Lord Jesus, we cannot but magnify as the only true greatness, and speak honourably of them. For this blessedness may we look amidst the trials of life, and when we feel the hand of death upon us; and seek it for our children after us.
